result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has vertically misaligned cards: the first card (Green Bowl Poké) sits higher than the second (Smash Bros Burgers) and third (Trattoria Piccola), whose images and text baselines are offset from one another, producing a ragged, broken-looking row. Other elements (header, promo banner, popular list, bottom nav) appear consistent.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the cards are not vertically aligned: the Green Bowl Poké card's image and title sit noticeably higher than the Smash Bros Burgers card, and the Trattoria Piccola card sits at yet another offset, so titles and delivery-fee lines do not share a common baseline and the row looks jagged/broken.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a consistent fixed height and top-align them (e.g. align-items: flex-start with equal image aspect ratios), so images, titles, and delivery info line up across cards.

issues.description: The delivery-time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') are placed at inconsistent positions on the card images: on the first card the badge overlaps the bottom-left of the image, while on the second and third cards it hangs lower over the image edge, reinforcing the misaligned appearance.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time badge to a consistent offset (e.g. bottom-left with fixed margin) relative to each card image so badges align across the carousel.
